evidence.claim: The paper introduces self-dual BB codes that support transversal CNOT, Hadamard, and S gates while targeting higher encoding rates than surface and color codes.
Theorem 1 gives the maximal logical dimension for a class of weight-6 self-dual BB codes, with the proof formulated using Laurent polynomial ideals and a Buchberger-algorithm calculation.

Tables I and II enumerate optimal weight-8 self-dual BB codes up to n=200 and report exact distances computed by integer programming; twisted-torus choices can realize the same stabilizer polynomial with different code parameters.
